name: motif_edit_phonological_rule_features
description:
Set rule features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Use only if a rule applies to some stems only, by exception feature, inflection class or category (inputCategories); otherwise narrow its context. Tag stems with compose-tag-stems-by-query (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Sets the exact exception features or inflection classes a phonological rewrite rule requires of a stem, and the ones it excludes, and the categories it is limited to. An empty list clears a set. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phonological-rule-features. Agent class: Draft.

rule.description: Id of an existing regular rule with one right-hand side; for several, use compose-edit-phonological-rule with rightHandSides.

required_features.description: Exact set of exception feature or inflection class ids a stem must all carry; an empty list clears it.

excluded_features.description: Exact set of ids a stem must carry none of; an empty list clears it.

input_categories.description: Exact set of part-of-speech ids (with their subcategories) the rule is limited to; an empty list admits every category. FieldWorks stores required categories only.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
